address.description: Business''s physical address - PO boxes, UPS drops, and FedEx drops are not acceptable; APO/FPO are acceptable.

dba_business_name.description: Any name that the business operates under that is not its legal business name (if applicable).

items.description: Business phone number, entered in E.164 format.
